<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Monetary policy shift:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India has raised the policy rate by 25 basis points, marking the first such increase in nearly four years.</li>
  <li><strong>Institutional protocols:</strong> The Election Commission maintains that no law obliges it to meet with political delegations, particularly under the irregular conditions proposed by the protesting opposition parties.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
